name: Bunica River Boat Experience
tagline: A relaxed boat outing on the Bunica River, in a quieter setting outside the city.
level: Easy; boarding access depends on the location
meetingPoint: Pickup in Mostar or an agreed location
availability: Depends on weather and the operator
description: Spend time on the Bunica River in a quieter natural setting outside the city. The boat outing heads towards the river spring and the surrounding landscape. When available and agreed in advance, the experience can include a taste of local seasonal fruit.

itinerary.text: Meet in Mostar or at the agreed departure point.
Travel to the river and board the boat.
Enjoy the boat outing and the views of the surroundings.
Taste seasonal local fruit, if available and included.

included: Fruit tasting only if confirmed by the operator
notIncluded: Food and drinks beyond the agreed tasting
practical: Life jackets and weather policy are confirmed with your booking.
notes: Confirm departure point, boat operator, passenger capacity, weather policy, life jackets, transport and current price.
seoTitle: Bunica River Boat Trip near Mostar
seoDescription: Relaxed boat outing on the Bunica River near Mostar, towards the river spring, with seasonal local fruit when available.
